cards.text: God's servant John is being shown a vision (Revelation 1:1), and he just watched the Lamb, Jesus (John 1:29), open the sixth seal. People on earth hid and asked who is able to withstand it (Revelation 6:12-17). Now, after this, John sees four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back its four winds.

cards.question: With the four winds held back by the angels, a breeze can still blow on the trees.

cards.text: Then John sees another angel coming up from the east, carrying a seal. And this one is NOT whispering when he calls out in a loud voice to the four angels.

cards.question: The seal this angel from the east is carrying is the seal of the living God.
The angel with the seal calls out to the four angels at the corners of the earth. What had those four been given power to do?

answers.text: Harm the land and the sea
Open the seals on the scroll

cards.text: His message to them is basically: not yet, not until one thing gets done first. Friend, it's holding the elevator door with your whole arm going WAIT, WAIT, ONE MORE!

cards.question: The angel tells the four angels not to harm the land, the sea or the trees until something happens first. What is it?

cards.text: The seal goes on the foreheads of God's servants. Then John hears the number of those who were sealed: 144,000.

cards.question: The 144,000 who were sealed come from all the tribes of ___.

cards.text: Then John hears it tribe by tribe, from Judah to Benjamin, with 12,000 sealed from each one. Every tribe named gets the exact same number. Friend, I can't split ONE batch evenly between two cookie boxes without somebody getting all the broken ones.

After this, John looks and sees a multitude too large to count, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. Friend, back when I was stuck in a junk drawer I counted falling dust for FUN, and even I would give up on this crowd.

cards.question: Where does this multitude too large to count come from?

answers.text: Every nation and tribe and tongue

cards.question: The multitude standing before the throne is dressed in sackcloth, like people in mourning.

cards.text: They're wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands. Then the whole multitude cries out in a loud voice.

cards.question: The multitude cries out: salvation to our ___, who sits on the throne, and to the ___!

cards.text: All the angels are standing around the throne, around the elders and the four living creatures who are around God's throne (Revelation 4:4, 6). Then the angels fall facedown before the throne and worship God.

Between an Amen at the start and an Amen at the end, they say blessing, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power and strength be to our God. That's SEVEN in a row, friend, and I've only got six toppings and I STILL mix those up.

cards.question: The angels say blessing, glory and all the rest belong to God forever and ever.

cards.text: Then one of the elders turns to John with a question about all these people in white robes.

cards.question: The elder asks John where the people in white robes have come from.

cards.text: John calls the elder sir and tells him he's the one who knows. Friend, I'm STEALING that move for the next time somebody asks me something I can't answer.

cards.question: So the elder tells John who the people in white robes are. What have they come out of?
The elder says the people in white robes have washed their robes and made them white. In what?

cards.text: For this reason, they're before the throne of God, serving Him day and night in His temple. And the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.

cards.question: The elder says the people in white robes will still hunger and thirst, just less than before.

cards.text: The elder quotes Isaiah 49:10: never again will they hunger or thirst, and no sun or scorching heat will beat down on them. Friend, I stand next to a hot oven ALL day, so that last part has Papa LISTENING.

cards.question: The elder tells John who will be the shepherd of the people in white robes. Who is it?

answers.text: The Lamb in the center of the throne
One of the elders by the throne
The angel who came from the east

cards.question: Quoting Isaiah 49:10 and 25:8, the elder says the Lamb will lead the people in white robes to springs of living ___, and God will wipe away every ___ from their eyes.

cards.text: Hold that picture, friend. John's vision keeps going after this, and so do we.
